text: The Government-led Landslide Risk Reduction and Mitigation Initiatives in Fiji (2020–2025) is a comprehensive portfolio of measures aimed at reducing landslide risks in Fiji. It is aligned with the Sendai Framework for Disaster Risk Reduction and the National Disaster Risk Reduction Policy. The initiatives focus on risk governance, hazard mapping, risk-informed land-use planning, infrastructure protection, and community preparedness. The program is coordinated by the National Disaster Management Office with technical leadership from the Mineral Resources Department and operational delivery by agencies like the Fiji Roads Authority.
